column1: # THE MARRIAGE OF PABLO ARMANDO LERENA AND MARY SEPTIMA TAYLOR.
# Duplicate Original Register no. 7271 (M.L.), entry 160. Read from David's image, 16 September 2026.
# *** THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE THIS DOCUMENT. *** It sat on the work list as "the 1911 Taylor
# marriage record" and was never found, because nobody looked in the family's own papers.

column3: Cape Colony printed form, bilingual English/Dutch. Other numbers on the sheet: 7328, 6884, and 816 in pencil.
*** Written in full, in his own hand at the foot: "Pablo Armando Lerena". Not Robert Paul. ***
*** Age last birthday. Consistent with 22 February 1882 to within a month. ***
*** The earliest dated attestation of the horse trade in this family - twenty years before the 1931 stables plans and twenty-nine before the passport says "Trainer". A DEALER, not yet a trainer. ***
*** The same village as the groom. They were neighbours before they were married. ***
*** Banns, not licence - called publicly, three Sundays, which requires settled local residence and no impediment. ***
Both of age; no parental consent required, and so no parent is named.
Signs twice: as celebrant, and certifying the duplicate "Examined with the Original Register by me, and found to be correct."
*** NOT READ. *** Something like "J. M. Wathington" and "A. H. Blackalock" - this archive will not print a guess as a reading. Flagged for a second look at higher resolution.

column1: # *** WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, AND THIS MATTERS MOST. ***
# *** THE CAPE MARRIAGE REGISTER OF 1911 HAS NO COLUMN FOR THE FATHERS OF THE PARTIES. ***
# There is no "father's name", no "father's rank or profession". The form asks name, age, race,
# condition, profession, residence, banns and consent, and nothing else. So this document CANNOT
# name Juan Carlos Lerena, and its absence there is a fact about the form and not about the family.
# 1. *** HE WAS A CATHOLIC, AND MARRIED IN A CATHOLIC CHURCH. *** St Dominic's, Wynberg, by an R.C.
#    priest, after banns. That is consistent with an Argentine or Italian or Spanish origin and it
#    is the first religious affiliation this archive has for him.
# 2. *** HORSE-DEALER, 1911. *** The trade is documented nine years earlier than anything else held.
# 3. *** HE WAS IN THE CAPE, SETTLED, WITH BANNS CALLED, IN 1911 *** - and Roque had been born there
#    in December 1905. The two together put the family at the Cape from 1905 at the latest.
# 4. Both parties of Diep River. Roque's baptism is at Corpus Christi, Wynberg - the same district.
# *** THE DISCREPANCY. *** The register gives the bride as 27 last birthday on 3 September 1911.
# This archive carries Mary Septima Taylor born *** 17 September 1884 *** on the GRO Bideford
# registration, which would make her 26 on that day - she turned 27 a fortnight after the wedding.
# *** The register is out by one year, or the birth year is 1883. *** Recorded, not smoothed. Her
# baptism of 30 October 1884 at Northam (ref 1843A/PR/1/16) is already held and supports 1884, so
# the likelier answer is that somebody rounded up to the birthday that was a fortnight away.

column2: *** THE ORIGINAL PAGE, READ AT FULL RESOLUTION 20 September 2026. *** Image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BP-73LY-N (apid TH-909-52895-100726-98), 2693x1757.
column3: *** FIRST WITNESS: 'J. M. Wathington'. *** The ending *** -ington *** is unambiguous at magnification, and this archive's earlier guess was right. *** SECOND WITNESS: the earlier guess 'A. H. Blackalock' is WRONG in its ending. *** The initials *** A. H. *** are clear and the surname ends *** -bach ***, not -lock. Best reading *** 'A. H. Blackabach' ***, and *** the middle of it is NOT secure *** - the letters between 'Black' and '-bach' are a single cursive run. *** Recorded as a reading with its uncertainty stated, which is what this row asked for instead of a guess. *** *** THE OFFICIANT IS CONFIRMED: 'Bertram W. Glynn, R.C. Priest' *** - and he is *** the same priest who baptised Roque at Corpus Christi Wynberg on 12 June 1911 ***, three months before this wedding. *** One priest, both acts, the same year. ***
